properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC key used to sign and verify access tokens (HS256). Required, at least 32 bytes. Set via JWT_SECRET.

properties.name: app.jwt.ttl
properties.description: How long an access token stays valid.

properties.name: app.admin.email
properties.description: Email of the initial admin seeded on startup. Seeding is skipped when blank.

properties.name: app.admin.password
properties.description: Password of the initial admin. Required when app.admin.email is set.

properties.name: app.admin.full-name
properties.description: Display name of the initial admin.
